debrief db-021

3) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r s-u-b-m-i-t-t-e-d f-a-b-r-i-c-a-t-e-d r-e-j-e-c-t i-o-n r-e-p-o-r-t-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g r-e-p-o-r-t d-o-c-u-m-e-n-t-s, a-n-d b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d c-o-n-t-e-n-t a-u-t-h-e-n-t-i-c-i-t-y r-e-v-i-e-w.
4) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r o-b-s-c-u-r-e-d d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e o-b-l-i-g-a-t-i-o-n-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g e-d-i-t-o-r i-n-t-e-r-f-a-c-e r-e-c-o-r-d-s, a-n-d i-g-n-o-r-e-d c-o-n-f-l-i-c-t d-i-s-c-l-o-s-u-r-e p-o-l-i-c-y.
5) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r m-a-n-i-p-u-l-a-t-e-d t-h-e s-y-s-t-e-m l-o-g-i-c f-o-r a-p-p-e-a-r-a-n-c-e, l-e-a-v-i-n-g a-l-t-e-r-e-d a-c-c-e-s-s t-o-k-e-n-s, a-n-d s-k-i-p-p-e-d a-u-d-i-t t-r-a-i-l v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
6) t-h-e a-c-t-o-r i-n-s-e-r-t-e-d c-o-o-r-d-i-n-a-t-e-d a-c-c-e-p-t a-n-c-e d-e-c-i-s-i-o-n-s, l-e-a-v-i-n-g p-u-b-l-i-c a-r-c-h-i-v-e e-n-t-r-i-e-s, a-n-d b-y-p-a-s-s-e-d m-u-l-t-i r-e-v-i-e-w-e-r v-e-r-i-f-i-c-a-t-i-o-n.
